name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Keychain With Mirror Acrylic Charms
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted with a 3mm transparent acrylic main piece featuring high-quality 2-sided printing, allowing the personalized artwork to be visible from both the front and back.
    - Includes custom 3mm mirror acrylic charms with precision-cut shapes and back engraving for personalized details.
    - Mirror acrylic charms are available in:
             +) Gold Mirror Acrylic
             +) Silver Mirror Acrylic
    - Personalized charms can be designed in a variety of custom shapes, including family members, couples, wedding symbols, names, religious symbols, dates, and other meaningful icons.
    - Comes with Silver O-Ring Clasps for securely attaching the main piece and individual charms.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Main piece options:
             +) 2 x 2 in ~ 5.08 x 5.08 cm
             +) 3 x 3 in ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm
             +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
    - Corresponding overall charm design area:
             +) Overall 2 x 2 in ~ 5.08 x 5.08 cm
             +) Overall 3 x 3 in ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm
             +) Overall 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
    - Minimum charm size: 2 cm.
    - Large Silver O-Ring Clasp:
             +) Diameter: 3.2 cm
             +) Thickness: 4mm
    - Small connecting ring diameter: 1 cm.
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Engraving & Printing Technology:
    - Transparent acrylic main piece features high-quality 2-sided UV printing for vibrant colors, detailed artwork, names, photos, messages, and personalized designs.
    - Mirror acrylic charms feature precision back engraving, allowing personalized names, dates, symbols, and decorative details to be displayed while maintaining a smooth reflective front surface.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized acrylic keychain featuring a custom printed main piece with detachable or attached mirror acrylic charms.
    - Suitable for customization with family members, couple designs, wedding details, baby information, names, dates, memorial symbols, religious icons, and other meaningful elements.
    - Individual charms can represent different people, milestones, relationships, or special memories.
    - The Silver O-Ring Clasp makes the keychain easy to attach to keys, handbags, backpacks, purses, luggage, or other personal accessories.
    - Lightweight yet durable for convenient everyday use and long-lasting keepsake value.
    - Suitable for both decorative use and meaningful personalized gifting.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for couples, families, parents, grandparents, newlyweds, new parents, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Christmas, weddings, anniversaries, baby celebrations, family milestones, memorial keepsakes, housewarmings, birthdays, and other special occasions.
    - Great for creating personalized family keychains with individual character charms representing parents, children, or loved ones.
    - Ideal for wedding keepsakes featuring meaningful symbols such as couples, wedding rings, names, or special dates.
    - A memorable personalized accessory that combines colorful custom printing with elegant Gold or Silver Mirror Acrylic charms.

  • Processing Time: 1-3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging:1 x Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Keychain With Mirror Acrylic Charms

 

PRODUCTION

  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
